US-521 DONE (Sprint 69 / V0.29.24, 10/11). Gyro-fused pitch + ZUPT replaces accel-only tilt as the gradePct source. Commit 58528f3.

SPRINT IS EFFECTIVELY CLOSED FOR RALPH. 10 of 11 pass. The only remaining story is US-504a, which is STILL BLOCKED on two rulings that arrived nowhere this sprint (PM/Atlas orphan policy for the drain-event writer; Spool's gate/band overlap, where his >=600s qualifying gate sits entirely ABOVE both sub-good bands so degraded/replace are unreachable). DO NOT START IT. It needs answers, not code.

THE ONE THE PM MUST CARRY TO THE DRILL: US-521's live validation CANNOT be done on wall power. ZUPT is gated on raw.obd.SPEED, which only publishes with OBD connected -- so the 'confirmed stop on a known slope' half of the validationCriteria needs an ENGINE-ON drive and folds into the SAME BL-025 validation drive as US-512. The 0.3g-on-flat-ground half is bench-testable. Two halves, two contexts; do not let a bench pass read as full acceptance.

WHAT I FOUND THAT THE AC DID NOT SAY: the pitch was not raw accel-only. US-478 low-passed the accel over 5s and read pitch off that, so a 1s acceleration IS rejected -- but a 10s on-ramp is 2 tau and propagates almost fully. The defect was real but DELAYED, which is why no bench test ever showed it. If you go looking for a naive atan(accel) you will not find one; look at gravityTauSec instead.

AND WHAT MADE IT SMALL: raw.imu.gyro has been on the bus since US-410 (same burst, same seq) and nobody subscribed; raw.obd.SPEED is on the SAME bus from the capture loop, gated by the same pi.bus.enabled that builds this bridge. So ZUPT needed ZERO new acquisition path -- two more subscription topics. The bridge is still a pure consumer: no I2C, no OBD connection, no A-17 race.

THE THING MOST LIKELY TO BE SILENTLY WRONG, so I derived it instead of guessing: the gyro sign. Right-handed forward x left = up, so omega x forward = -omega_left * up, i.e. NOSE UP IS A NEGATIVE LEFT-AXIS RATE. If this were flipped the two halves of the filter would fight and the estimate would be worse than either alone. Mutation-proved (3 red). Documented in the function.

MUTATION TESTING CAUGHT A BAD TEST OF MINE -- say this out loud rather than claiming 6/6. Mutant 'confirm a stop on ELAPSED time instead of OBSERVED span' SURVIVED the first run: my test was being saved by the freshness guard, not by the rule it claimed to test. Fixed (widened the freshness window in that test so it cannot mask, plus a new slow-poll test: two zero readings 2s apart = 2s of evidence + 1s of hope, must not confirm). All 6 kill now. The general lesson, and it is new: when two guards defend the same outcome, a test 'for' one of them proves nothing until you disable the other.

THE NEGATIVE CASE THAT MATTERS MOST is the same shape as US-518's route gate: a STALE speed, not a failed one. If BT drops while stopped at a light (BL-025 is not hypothetical), the last thing heard is 'speed 0' -- honouring it would hard-snap the attitude to the 16.7deg phantom on every on-ramp for the rest of the drive, with MORE confidence than the drift it was fixing. Guarded twice (2s freshness, below the 3s gate; plus observed-span not elapsed-time). Absent speed is never zero speed: bench Pi confirms no stops and claims no bias.

SPOOL OWES A REPLY BEFORE US-519/US-520. Filed offices/tuner/inbox/2026-08-02-from-ralph-us521-pitch-fusion-shipped-sigma-sizing.md with the real rates (50Hz burst/fusion, 10Hz state write, ~1Hz SPEED) and the accelTrustBand arithmetic. His [EXACT:3]s gate is 3.0 verbatim with its own test. Everything else is Rex-derived and named as such. Two items in it change his error model: no OBD = no ZUPT = unconverged bias forever (US-519 should probably refuse to integrate in that state), and the bias does NOT persist across a restart (~5 stops to re-converge each boot).

SCOPE HELD: his US-508 items 2/3 (integrand gate >=5km/h & <0.15g, slew clamp 0.15) are NOT here -- they belong to US-519, deferred. Nothing publishes an altitude; states/imu.altitude is still typed-null/no_source. No carousel change: gradePct's name and units are unchanged, pitchDeg is published for US-519 per AC3, and displaying it is US-520.

48 tests, 6 mutations, 310 green in-loop (tests/pi/sensors + tests/pi/bus + config validator + 2 UI imu files), ruff clean, validate_config passes. architecture.md 10.8 updated in-sprint (design gate). Honest about RED: run 1 was one ModuleNotFoundError, not 35 witnessed failures -- which is exactly why the mutations were run.

TWO PRE-EXISTING REDS STILL ON THIS BRANCH AND THEY WILL FAIL THE PM INTEGRATION GATE: I-041 (US-505's drive.lastDrive vs 2 exact-shape guards in tests/pi/splash/test_system_status_emitter.py, ~2-line fix) and TD-073 (tests/lint/test_ralph_promise_tag_contract.py). Neither is mine, both are documented, both are cheap. That is now THREE stories in a row reporting the same pattern: a scoped in-loop selection cannot see the EXISTING guard for a contract it changes. I avoided it here only because I went looking for the states/imu exact-shape guard on purpose and updated it in the same commit. Worth a middle tier in TD-059's in-loop/PM-gate split -- 'run the existing tests for any contract you edit', which is mechanically derivable from the touched files.
